newsitem.title: CHINA: China key rubber firms profits double in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China key rubber firms profits double in 1996.

text.p: The post-tax profits of China's 100 key rubber firms hit 550 million yuan ($66.3 million) in 1996, up from 226 million yuan the previous year, an official with the Ministry of Chemical Industry said on Thurday.
The pre-tax profits of the firms, which included rubber makers and manufacturers of rubber products, reached 3.5 billion yuan last year, up 19.1 percent from the previous year, the official said.
China's rubber industry saw great losses in 1995 due to rising prices of raw materials both at home and abroad, he said.
In 1996, rubber industry authorities adopted a series of measures to cut costs, save energy and increase output, he said without giving further details.
